Where I beganTwo years later
Our Story

I built Antra Active for the woman I used to be.

I started at 76 kg. Over two years of strength training, on my own terms and at my own pace, I came down to 50 kg.

Along the way, I kept having to replace my sportswear. Nothing grew with me. In the beginning I hid in oversized shirts, hoping no one would look twice. Today I wear what I love, with confidence, and I no longer feel the need to hide.

Your clothes should meet you wherever you are in your journey, not make you wish you were somewhere else.

Antra Active is made for women in the beginning or the middle of theirs. Because you deserve nothing but the best, at every stage.

Strength training tips and my own journey: @ritmsfitness

— Founder, Antra Active

Walk through the years with me.

Five years, from where I began to Antra Active. Tap any tag to turn it over.

2022
The beginning
  1. 2022SizeXL76 kg

    Where I began.

    I was 76 kg and wearing XL. I lived in oversized shirts, hoping no one would look too closely. Then I started strength training, on my own terms.

    2022

    What changed

    I started my own strength training journey.

    What I'd tell you now

    You don't need a perfect plan. You just need to begin.

  2. 2023

    Nothing fit for long.

    My body kept changing, and my sportswear didn't keep up. I kept replacing what I owned and wondering why nothing was made for this stage.

    2023

    What changed

    I kept showing up, and my wardrobe kept falling behind.

    What I'd tell you now

    Progress isn't always on the scale. Sometimes your clothes tell you first.

  3. 2024SizeS50 kg

    Two years, 26 kg lighter.

    After two years of strength training I was a size S and 50 kg. I wasn't hiding in oversized shirts anymore.

    2024

    What changed

    I stopped hiding and started wearing what I loved.

    What I'd tell you now

    Strength builds far more than muscle.

  4. 2025SizeXS

    The year I saw the gap.

    I went from S to XS, and I realised I wasn't the only one. Women across India were struggling to find good activewear that fit and felt right.

    2025

    What changed

    I spent the year learning who I could help.

    What I'd tell you now

    It was never you. The clothes weren't made with you in mind.

  5. 2026

    Antra Active was born.

    I started posting about fitness, and soon enough Antra Active was born, for women in the beginning or middle of their journey.

    2026

    What changed

    A personal journey became a brand.

    What I'd tell you now

    Wherever you are, you deserve nothing but the best.
